title: Gig Workers' Social Security: Pension & Insurance Prospects
description: The Indian government is establishing a National Social Security Board for unorganised, gig, and platform workers. This board aims to design and recommend tar.

faq.a: A gig worker is an individual who performs work or participates in a work arrangement outside of a traditional employer-employee relationship, earning from activities that generate income. This includes platform workers who use online platforms to connect with clients or customers.

faq.q: What is the National Social Security Board?
faq.a: The National Social Security Board is a body being established by the Indian government to design, monitor, and recommend welfare schemes specifically for unorganised, gig, and platform workers, ensuring they receive social security benefits.

faq.q: Will these benefits be mandatory for gig workers?
faq.a: The specifics of whether contributions or participation will be mandatory are yet to be detailed by the Board. However, many social security schemes aim for broad coverage, and the Board's recommendations will clarify this aspect.

faq.q: When can gig workers expect these benefits?
faq.a: The Board's formation is a significant first step. After its establishment, it will need time to design, recommend, and for the government to notify and implement specific schemes. It's a phased process, and updates will be provided by the Ministry of Labour & Employment.

faq.q: How will contributions be made for these schemes?
faq.a: Contributions could potentially be made by gig workers themselves, platform companies, or the government, or a combination of these, similar to existing social security models. The Board's recommendations will outline the contribution structure.

faq.q: Are platform companies required to contribute?
faq.a: The Code on Social Security, 2020, includes provisions for platform aggregators to contribute to social security funds for gig workers. The extent and mechanism of these contributions will be defined in the schemes designed by the Board.

faq.q: What kind of insurance benefits are expected?
faq.a: Expected insurance benefits include health insurance, covering medical expenses and potentially maternity, as well as life and disability insurance to provide financial protection in case of unforeseen events like accidental death or permanent disability.
